title: A301 운영 서버
description: Production server (single Lightsail instance). Read top to bottom: overview → server → apps (BE, AI, LiveKit) → storage (Redis, PostgreSQL) → FE → per-container details.

panels.title: 서버 CPU
panels.description: Average over the last 5 minutes, across all 4 cores

panels.title: 서버 메모리
panels.description: Used (total - available) out of 15GB

panels.title: 디스크 (/)
panels.description: DB, logs, metrics and temporary recording files all live on this disk

panels.title: Redis 메모리
panels.description: Used vs maxmemory. When full, Redis rejects writes and logins and interviews break (noeviction)

panels.title: 진행 중인 면접방
panels.description: Rooms currently open on LiveKit

panels.title: 면접방 참가자
panels.description: Counts users, the AI interviewer and recording participants

panels.title: 녹화 중
panels.description: Recordings currently running on Egress

panels.title: DB 연결
panels.description: Connections vs PostgreSQL max_connections

panels.title: 메모리 초과 종료 (1시간)
panels.description: Containers killed for exceeding their memory limit (mem_limit)

panels.title: 지표 수집 실패
panels.description: Scrape targets Prometheus could not read. If not 0, the related panels are empty

panels.title: CPU 사용률
panels.description: Stacked by mode. High iowait means the CPU is waiting on disk

panels.title: Load average
panels.description: Above the core count (4), tasks are waiting for CPU

panels.title: 메모리
panels.description: Used = total - available (excludes cache)

panels.title: 서버 네트워크
panels.description: Traffic to and from the outside (excludes Docker bridges). Mostly LiveKit media. Check the monthly Lightsail transfer quota in the Lightsail console

panels.title: BE 평균 응답 시간 (요청 발생 시)
BE 상세 (엔드포인트 · 주기 작업 · DB · Redis · JVM)
BE 엔드포인트별 p95 응답 시간 (5분, 상위 10)

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{job="a301-be",uri!~"UNKNOWN|/\\*\\*"}[5m]))))

panels.description: Slowest 10 endpoints by p95 over 5 minutes. Requests rejected before routing (UNKNOWN, /**) are excluded

panels.title: BE 응답 결과별 요청 수 / 초
panels.description: CLIENT_ERROR = 4xx, SERVER_ERROR = 5xx. A rise in 4xx often means expired logins or a client bug

panels.title: BE 최대 응답 시간 (엔드포인트별 상위 5)
panels.description: Slowest single request per endpoint in the recent window (resets every 2 minutes)

panels.title: BE 로그 ERROR · WARN (5분)
panels.description: Count of ERROR and WARN log lines. Open the logs dashboard to see the lines

panels.title: BE 주기 작업 최대 실행 시간
panels.description: @Scheduled jobs (AI job republish every 5s, practice alarms, company card import, daily metrics)

panels.title: BE 주기 작업 실패 · 스케줄러 사용 중
panels.description: Failures per job in 5 minutes and busy scheduler threads (pool size 4). Busy = pool size means jobs are delayed

panels.title: BE DB 연결 획득 대기 시간
panels.description: Time to borrow a connection from the pool. Grows when the pool is exhausted

panels.title: BE 리포지토리 메서드 최대 실행 시간 (상위 10)
panels.description: Slowest Spring Data repository methods. Use it to find slow queries

panels.title: BE → Redis 명령 평균 지연
panels.description: Excludes BLMOVE, the blocking wait for AI results, which would dominate the average. Errors are listed separately

panels.title: BE GC 부담 · GC 후 힙
panels.description: GC overhead = share of CPU time spent in GC. Heap after GC that keeps rising means a leak

panels.title: BE 스레드 상태
panels.description: Rising blocked threads mean lock contention

panels.title: 에이전트 지표 수집
panels.description: 1 = Prometheus can read the agent's /metrics (port 9464)

panels.title: 진행 중인 면접 (에이전트)
panels.description: Interviews the agent is running now

panels.title: Soniox 음성 (선택 기간)
panels.description: Audio sent to Soniox STT in the selected time range. Billed by length

panels.title: ElevenLabs 글자 (선택 기간)
panels.description: Characters synthesized successfully in the selected range. Billed by characters

panels.title: Jev 리액션 판단 (선택 기간)
panels.description: Reaction requests per sentence, all results

panels.title: Jev 인상 판단 (선택 기간)
panels.description: Camera snapshot requests, about one per second while answering

panels.title: 진행 중인 면접
panels.description: Agent count vs LiveKit rooms. Rooms without an agent mean the interview did not start

panels.title: 음성 API 사용량 (5분)
panels.description: Soniox seconds on the left axis, ElevenLabs characters on the right

panels.title: Jev 요청 결과 (5분)
panels.description: Reaction timeout is 0.8s, impression timeout is 5s

panels.title: Jev 실패 비율 (timeout + error, 5분)
panels.description: On failure the interview continues without a reaction

panels.title: 패킷 손실률
panels.description: incoming = browser → server, outgoing = server → browser. Even a few percent makes video and audio stutter

panels.title: 입장 실패 · 녹화 결과 (5분)
panels.description: Join failures are drops during signaling or media connection. Recording results count finished recordings by result

panels.title: Redis 메모리
panels.description: Redis rejects writes when it reaches the limit (192MB)

panels.title: Redis 키 수
panels.description: The app only uses db0. Keys with expiry (sessions, tokens) are removed over time

panels.title: Redis 오류 (5분)
panels.description: OOM means memory was full and writes were rejected

panels.title: DB 연결 수
panels.description: Long-lived "idle in transaction" means a transaction was left uncommitted

panels.title: 캐시 적중률
panels.description: Share of reads served from memory instead of disk. A drop means memory is short

panels.title: 가장 오래 열린 트랜잭션
panels.description: Longest transaction by state. Long ones hold locks and connections

panels.title: FE 첫 화면 응답 시간 (서버 측 검사)
컨테이너별 CPU
panels.description: 1 = one full core. The server has 4

panels.title: 메모리 상한 대비 (지금)
panels.description: Usage vs compose mem_limit. At 100% the container is killed

panels.title: 컨테이너별 네트워크 (보내기)
panels.description: Mostly LiveKit and Egress

panels.title: 가동 시간
panels.description: A short uptime means the container was recently deployed or restarted

panels.title: 재시작 · 메모리 초과 종료 (최근 1시간)
panels.description: Restarts count the same container starting again (containers recreated by a deploy are not counted)
